business.name: Honeybun
business.hoursNote: Hours as listed on Just Eat – please check before travelling.

sections.title: Smash Burgers
sections.kicker: Big Flavour · Fresh Ingredients · Always a Hit
sections.blurb: Fresh beef, pressed hard onto a screaming-hot griddle for those lacy, caramelised edges. Every one comes stacked with turkey rashers, pickles, onions, lettuce, cheese and mayo.

items.name: Double Smash Burger
items.desc: Two beef patties smashed thin for crispy, caramelised edges, layered with turkey rashers, tangy pickles, onions, crisp lettuce, melted cheese and creamy mayo.

items.name: Single Smash Burger
items.desc: One hand-smashed beef patty seared until crisp, topped with turkey rashers, pickles, diced onions, lettuce, melted cheese and mayo.

items.name: King Gourmet Burger
items.desc: A thick Americano gourmet beef patty with smoky turkey rashers, crunchy pickles, onions, crisp lettuce, melted cheese and rich mayo.

items.name: King Cheese Burger
items.desc: A seasoned Texan Angus beef patty seared to lock in the juices, layered with turkey rashers, pickles, onions, lettuce and gooey melted cheese.

sections.title: Chicken & Wraps
sections.blurb: Golden fried chicken with a shatter-crisp coating – in a toasted bun or rolled tight in a warm tortilla.

items.name: Honeybun Chicken Burger
items.desc: A thick, golden fried chicken fillet with a shatteringly crisp coating, topped with onions, lettuce and tangy pickles.

items.name: Flaming Chicken Burger
items.desc: Extra-crispy spicy fried chicken drenched in fiery sauce, cooled down with mayo, crunchy lettuce, onions and gherkins.

items.name: Chicken Wrap
items.desc: Crispy chicken with lettuce, onions, crunchy pickles and cool mayo, wrapped tight in a warm flour tortilla.

items.name: BBQ Chicken Wrap
items.desc: Fried chicken tossed in sweet, smoky BBQ sauce and rolled in a toasted tortilla with lettuce, onions and pickles.

sections.title: Peri Peri
sections.blurb: Flame-grilled chicken basted in your choice of heat – from zesty lemon & herb all the way up to extra hot.

items.name: Whole
items.desc: A whole chicken, marinated and flame-grilled to tender perfection.

items.name: Half
items.desc: Half a chicken, charred and smoky outside, juicy inside.

items.name: Quarter
items.desc: A quarter portion, cooked to order.

items.name: 6 Wings
items.desc: Six plump wings, flame-kissed on the grill.

items.name: 10 Wings
items.desc: Ten charred wings packed with smoky heat.

items.name: 15 Wings
items.desc: A sharing pile of fifteen – bring friends. Or don't.

sections.title: Fries & Meal Deal
sections.blurb: Make it a meal: add fries and a drink to any burger, chicken or wrap order for just £2.99.

_whenPeriReturns.blurb: Make it a meal: add fries and a drink to any burger, chicken, wrap or peri peri order for just £2.99.

items.name: Honeybun Fries
items.desc: Golden, crunchy and fluffy inside. Served in the famous pink box.

items.name: Peri Peri Fries
items.desc: Crispy fries tossed in a punchy peri peri and masala seasoning.

sections.title: Feasts & Bundles
sections.kicker: Built to Share · Just Eat Exclusive
sections.blurb: Bundles currently available to order on Just Eat.

items.name: Ultimate Solo Smash Feast
items.desc: A smash burger with seasoned fries and an ice-cold can.

items.name: Flaming Solo Wrap Box
items.desc: Chicken or BBQ chicken wrap with skin-on fries and a cold drink.

items.name: Duo Peri Peri Flame Box
items.desc: Half a peri peri chicken, ten wings in your heat and two regular fries.

items.name: Smash & Cluck Partner Pack
items.desc: A Double Smash, a Honeybun Chicken Burger and two meal deal upgrades.

items.name: Sovereign Royal Feast
items.desc: A whole peri peri chicken, 15 wings, two King Gourmet Burgers, two fries and two drinks.

sections.title: Waffles & Crêpes

items.name: Speculoos

items.name: Kinder Bueno

sections.title: Milkshakes
